1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: After a chance encounter with Grand Prince I-AN, chaebol heiress Seong Huiju schemes to rise higher.

1.name: Episode 2
1.overview: Huiju is pushed to meet with potential suitors. Grand Prince I-AN considers accepting her proposal.

1.name: Episode 3
1.overview: A secret rendezvous scandal rocks the royal family, and Grand Prince I-AN makes a public statement.

1.name: Episode 4
1.overview: When Huiju moves into Grand Prince I-AN's residence and proves to be a handful, a conspiracy awaits…

1.name: Episode 5
1.overview: As Huiju digs for the truth, Grand Prince I-AN distances himself thinking it is safer to stay away.

1.name: Episode 6
1.overview: The celebrated pair makes a dazzling return at the banquet, waltzing and professing their fake love.

1.name: Episode 7
1.overview: With the wedding looming, everyone begins to realize a strange turn in the couple's relationship.

1.name: Episode 8
1.overview: The 21st-century Grand Prince's wife arrives. Amid cheers and wary eyes, two men make a bold choice.

1.name: Episode 9
1.overview: Facing a political crisis, the couple choose to fight to protect one another, each in their own way.

1.name: Episode 10
1.overview: Others step in for the couple who struggle to be honest, and a new era begins to stir at the court.

1.name: Episode 11
1.overview: Like that day, fire engulfs Council Hall. Huiju protects Grand Prince I-AN while fighting an enemy.

1.name: Episode 12
1.overview: No barrier is unbreakable, only those who wish it so. Can they leap beyond and shape their destiny?

overview: در دنیای مدرنِ یک پادشاهی مشروطه، جایی که ظاهر و جایگاه اجتماعی هنوز نقش مهمی دارند، زنی مستقل و موفق با وجود داشتن همه‌چیز، همچنان بیرون از دایره اشرافیت قرار دارد. زندگی او زمانی دگرگون می‌شود که به‌طور اتفاقی با یک شاهزاده آشنا می‌شود، مردی که با وجود عنوان و قدرت ظاهری‌اش، در درون احساس محدودیت و بی‌اختیاری می‌کند. با نزدیک‌تر شدن این دو، آن‌ها نه‌تنها با احساسات پیچیده خود روبه‌رو می‌شوند، بلکه باید با فشارهای جامعه، قوانین نانوشته سلطنت و انتظارات اطرافیان نیز مقابله کنند و ...

seasons.overview: A class-defying romance between a prince with nothing but status and a woman who lacks only that.

tagline: A royal deal… that changed everything.
title: Perfect Crown
